'''Forry''', designated '''CT-44/444''', was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Ord Cestus Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He specialized in physical training. Along with his fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] commandos [[Seefor]] and [[Sirty]], Forry attempted to stop [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha ARC]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jangotat|Nate]] from violating their code, which Nate was doing by not following the instructions that [[Jedi General/Legends|Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Fisto]] gave them. When Nate tried to leave, Forry and Nate squared off. Nate won by landing a blow on Forry's jaw.

Forry helped Fisto and Nate train the commandos of the [[Desert Wind]] terrorist group. He was among the survivors who managed to escape their lair when [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] sent a group of [[Assassin droid/Legends|infiltration droids]] to destroy them. When Nate's body was not recovered, they feared that Nate had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] or that he had broken the Code and betrayed them.
